lifecycle: LIFECYCLE NRND: W25Q64JVxIQ (U4) is not recommended for new designs by its vendor (Winbond Parts Catalog export winbond-W25Q64JV-catalog-export-2026-11-16.csv exported by Scotty 2026-11-16, column 15 Status-Industrial = N for all 16 xIQ codes (legend N = Not Recommended for New Design, relayed: not in the export); SSIQ screenshots 73aa6c75 (N) and 7091ccdc (Longevity Y since 2016/03); DigiKey: Active (not held)), acknowledged in accept_lifecycle
capacitance: upper bound estimated from routed geometry
conditions: scope: the bare board's copper and each I2C pin's Ci; part bodies, solder and terminations above the pads are not included
laminate and solder mask relative permittivity at most 5.4 (the IPC-4101 FR-4 maximum, specified at 1 MHz)
finished copper at most 70 um thick; finished board from 0.34 mm to 2.0 mm thick
zone fill keeps the board's clearance (the DRC gate refills and judges it)
every I2C pin at most UM10204's Ci of 10 pF; no multiplexer or switch on the line
neighbouring nets are static while the line rises
on SCK and MOSI, each device pin at its part's cited maximum pin capacitance (parts table); the MCU's own pin drives the line and is not counted (DS12117 Table 149's C is the external load)
supply: R is a certified upper bound (Thomson's principle) on a subset of the net's copper: every flux-carrying cell lies wholly inside copper the gate reads; copper left out only raises it

supply: every hole anywhere within +-0.075 mm per axis of its pad (JLCPCB PCB capabilities, jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 18 Nov 2026: Drilling, Hole Position Tolerance, "+/-0.075 mm")

supply: every finished hole from 0.08 mm under to 0.13 mm over its drawn size (JLCPCB PCB capabilities, jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 18 Nov 2026: Drilling, Hole size Tolerance, "Through-holes: +0.13 / -0.08 mm" / JLCPCB PCB capabilities, jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 18 Nov 2026: Drilling, Hole size Tolerance, "Through-holes: +0.13 / -0.08 mm"), lined by at least the declared plating minimum
supply: every track at 0.8 of its drawn width (JLCPCB PCB capabilities, jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 18 Nov 2026: Traces, Track width tolerance, "+/-20%")
supply: pads and via pads at their drawn size: no pad etch tolerance is cited
supply: each terminal pad an equipotential: the current enters and leaves through the whole pad
supply: the source is where the regulator's current enters the domain (a buck's inductor pad); at DC it is the net's highest potential, so the bound covers the regulator's sense point too
supply: the return is the regulator's own ground pin; other domains' return currents in the ground copper are not bounded
supply: the load's VDD and VSS pins are tied inside it, so the worst supply pin and the worst return pin bound its drop [inferred]
supply: copper resistivity IACS x (1 + 0.00393 x (T - 20)) x 1.181 (IPC-MF-150F 3.8.1.2's foil maximum, applied to plated copper as a stated condition), at the declared copper temperature maximum
supply: plane fill at least the outline less 0.625 mm and each knockout's measured 0.2025 mm clearance and 0.125 mm min-thickness opening (KiCad 10.0.7, measured)
supplies.resistance: upper bound certified from routed geometry
